title: Y2K与Balletcore双风格时尚趋势分析
titleEn: Fashion Trend Analysis of Y2K & Balletcore
subtitle: 时尚趋势调研课程作业
description: 对比解析Y2K千禧辣妹风与Balletcore芭蕾少女风两大主流时尚风格，梳理二者起源、视觉特征与市场穿搭表现。
descriptionEn: Comparative analysis of two mainstream fashion aesthetics: Y2K millennial style and Balletcore ballet girl style, sorting out their origins, visual features and market dressing performance.
concept: 拆解两种当下热门少女向时尚风格的审美逻辑，对比色彩、版型、配饰差异，总结风格背后的青年流行文化心理。
conceptEn: Deconstruct the aesthetic logic of two popular youth fashion styles, compare differences in color, silhouette and accessories, and summarize youth cultural psychology behind the trends.
roleDetail: 小组作业，参与项目前期创意构思，负责报告配图素材搜集，后期统一整套调研手册的版式排版。
roleDetailEn: Group course project. Took part in preliminary ideation, collected all reference images for the report, and unified the layout of the complete research booklet in post-production.
